task05.endianStrategy: H8DM flag bit0 declares little-endian. Header, directory, and section table are manually byte-shifted little-endian. Record body emission currently copies struct memory after refusing big-endian editor hosts; cross-platform runtime also refuses non-little-endian before reading structs. Future true big-endian support requires per-record byte swapping before WriteStruct.
